name: codexbar
title: CodexBar
description: CodexBar wrapper that lets you check coding agent usage directly from Raycast.
author: raulg

commands.name: usage-overview
commands.title: Usage Overview
commands.subtitle: CodexBar
commands.description: Show usage overview of all configured providers

commands.name: refresh-usage-cache
commands.title: Refresh Usage Cache
commands.subtitle: CodexBar
commands.description: Refresh cached usage data and provider status in the background so the overview opens instantly

preferences.name: hidePersonalInfo
preferences.title: Advanced
preferences.label: Hide Personal Information
preferences.description: Hide provider account emails, account labels, and organizations in the detail view.

preferences.name: disableKeychainAccess
preferences.label: Disable Keychain Access
preferences.description: Prevent CodexBar processes launched by this extension from reading or writing macOS Keychain. Some Providers may become unavailable; configure another authentication source in the CodexBar app.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
